drills.title: Transport, hotels and plans
drills.instructions: Choose the best answer. Check the explanation after you finish.

questions.prompt: Lunch is included. You ____ bring food.
questions.explanation: It is already provided, so bringing food is optional.

questions.prompt: ____ he have to show his ticket?
questions.explanation: With he, use Does + subject + have to.

questions.prompt: We’re going ____ take the early coach.
questions.explanation: Be going to is followed by the base verb.

questions.prompt: The train departs at 8:40. Meet 10 minutes before departure. When?
HOTEL: Check-in starts at 2 p.m. Early guests may leave bags at reception. Which is true?
options: A room is ready as soon as a guest arrives.
Guests can leave bags before 2 p.m.
Guests must carry bags after 2 p.m.
questions.answer: Guests can leave bags before 2 p.m.
questions.explanation: Early guests may leave luggage at reception.

questions.prompt: You want to check whether breakfast costs extra. What do you ask?
questions.explanation: Included means covered by the room price.

illustration.alt: Two people arriving at a small performance hall

drills.title: Experiences and invitations
drills.instructions: Choose the best answer. Check the explanation after you finish.

questions.prompt: Have you ever ____ to a film festival?
questions.explanation: Use the past participle after have.

questions.prompt: I ____ a live show with my cousin last Friday.
questions.explanation: Last Friday is a finished past time.
Seen is the past participle of see.

questions.prompt: Would you like ____ to a concert?
questions.explanation: Use Would you like to + verb to invite someone.

questions.prompt: Thanks for asking. I can’t go tonight, but I’m free tomorrow. What does the speaker do?
questions.explanation: The speaker is unavailable tonight but offers tomorrow.

questions.prompt: The singer was great, but it was difficult to hear the words. What is the speaker's problem?
questions.explanation: It was difficult to hear the words, despite enjoying the singer.

interview: How do you usually travel to school?
What do you like to do on weekends?
